title: Transport of an equal pair of additive Cech augmentation classes
statement: Let g:Y to X be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U and V finite indexed families of opens such that every V tuple intersection lies in the g-preimage of its U tuple intersection. Let I,J resolve the respective fixed lifted additive structure sheaves [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], with canonical comparisons c_X,c_Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Fix n and Cech cycles z,z_prime whose target coordinates are structural pullbacks of source coordinates restricted along the tuple inclusions [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change]. Suppose supplied global cycle s and total cycles t_alpha,t_beta have inclusions alpha(s),beta(z) and equal total classes [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization]. Then there are target cycles s_prime,t_alpha_prime,t_beta_prime with inclusions alpha(s_prime),beta(z_prime) and equal total classes, and c_Y([s_prime]) equals H^n(q_g)(cohomologyMap(g)(c_X([s]))), where q_g is the adjoint of etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image,def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No normalized edge equivalence is used or asserted. No covering, affineness, separatedness, compactness or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 20.15.1, augmented resolution pentagon and refinement section maps; Tag 03P2 identifies the coefficient sections.

proof.text: Let x be H^n(q_g)(cohomologyMap(g)(c_X([s])) and let y=c_Y^{-1}(x). Since homologyπ is epi in AddCommGrpCat, it is surjective. Choose a cycle s_prime mapping to y. The inverse identity for c_Y proves c_Y([s_prime])=x. This is a quotient representative, not a geometric transfer assertion.

Apply the prescribed-class augmentation compatibility theorem to this s_prime and its proved class equation. Obtain t_alpha_prime and t_beta_prime with the two augmentation inclusions and equal total classes. Combine these witnesses with the class equation proved in the first step.

theorem etaleAdditiveCech_augmentation_transfer
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (J : InjectiveResolution Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (cX : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison X.etaleAdditiveSheaf I)
    (cY : Etale.ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf J)
    (n : ℕ)
    (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
    (z' : (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n)
    (hcoords : ∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ι,
            cechCoordinate Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) n y
                ((cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z') =
              (show Y.Modules from SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (hinter n y)).op
                ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app
                  (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))
                  (cechCoordinate X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) n y
                    ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U
                      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z))))
    (s : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n)
    (tα tβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n)
    (hα : (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tα =
      additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s))
    (hβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tβ = additiveCechBeta U I n
      ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z))
    (heq : (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tα =
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tβ) :
    ∃ (s' : (additiveCechGlobal J).cycles n)
      (tα' tβ' : (additiveCechTotal V J).cycles n),
      (additiveCechTotal V J).iCycles n tα' =
        additiveCechAlpha V J n ((additiveCechGlobal J).iCycles n s') ∧
      (additiveCechTotal V J).iCycles n tβ' = additiveCechBeta V J n
        ((cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V
          (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z') ∧
      (additiveCechTotal V J).homologyπ n tα' =
        (additiveCechTotal V J).homologyπ n tβ' ∧
      cY.globalEquiv n ((additiveCechGlobal J).homologyπ n s') =
        Sheaf.H.map
          (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction _ g).homEquiv _ _).symm
            (Scheme.etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar g)) n
          (Etale.cohomologyMap g X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n
            (cX.globalEquiv n ((additiveCechGlobal I).homologyπ n s)))
